title: I ported Kubernetes to the browser
summary: Ngrok engineer Tyler Charboneau ported k3s (lightweight Kubernetes) to run entirely in the browser using WebAssembly and JavaScript, enabling containerized workloads to execute client-side with zero server infrastructure. The project includes a live demo at webernetes-demo.ngrok.app and full source code on GitHub.
problem_solved: Enables running full Kubernetes clusters in the browser for demos, testing, and learning without requiring any backend server infrastructure.
why_valuable: Allows developers to experiment with real Kubernetes locally in a browser tab, democratizing access to container orchestration for education and rapid prototyping.
